projects.name: Paper Harbor
projects.description: A small storefront with typed product search, a persistent cart, and transactional demo checkout.

preview.alt: Paper Harbor storefront with product search, notebook and pen listings, cart, and demo checkout form

projects.disclosure: Checkout stores a pending demo order. No payment is collected or sent to a provider.

projects.name: Job Booking
projects.tagline: A clear view of the day’s work.
projects.description: An operations workspace for customers, jobs, schedules, workers, and role-aware actions.

preview.alt: Job Booking Manager jobs workspace with schedule form, search, and job table

projects.disclosure: This is a reference application. It does not provide hosted scheduling, messaging, or payment services.

projects.name: PulseBoard
projects.tagline: Plan clearly. Move quickly. Finish well.
projects.description: A workspace task dashboard with persisted tasks, memberships, owner and manager roles, settings, and bounded pages.

preview.alt: PulseBoard workspace task dashboard with summary, task form, and bounded task table

projects.disclosure: Membership invitations and removal are not implemented. Search and sort operate on the visible server page.

projects.name: Community Issues
projects.description: A repository-scoped issue tracker with authenticated browsing, literal search, cursor pages, comments, and role-checked status changes.

preview.alt: Community Issues app listing three repository issues with state, reporter, and detail links

projects.disclosure: This is not a GitHub replacement. It has no Git integration, pull requests, or audit history.

projects.name: Tidehouse
projects.tagline: A little closer to the Atlantic.
projects.description: A photo-led guesthouse experience inspired by São Miguel in the Azores, with sample pages for the house, rooms, and island.

preview.alt: Photo-led guesthouse on São Miguel, with a stone house, room, coast, and breakfast photography

projects.disclosure: Visual example only. It does not provide live availability, booking, payment, or a real guesthouse service.
